{{Quote|The Vagaari must have had rooms like this aboard their vessels. ''[&hellip;]'' Larger even than this, perhaps. They had huge fleets.|The Vagaari|<ref name="SQ" />}}
A '''Vagaari''' [[Battle of the Redoubt|infiltrated]] the remains of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Outbound Flight]]''<ref name="SQ" /> in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> along with [[Vagaari Empire]] [[Supreme Commander (Vagaari)|Supreme Commander]] [[Estosh]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bearsh]], the Vagaari [[Purpsh]], and nearly three hundred [[Vagaari soldier]]s. While visiting the remains of the vessel in [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]], the infiltrator commented that the Vagaari had rooms as large as the ones within ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]''&mdash;one of the nine [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] that formed ''Outbound Flight''.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]''.<ref name="SQ" />
